text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their skills begins.
This season is the ultimate opportunity for major growth—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Still in Love shouldn't be very good with sunlight
or heat. Taking the time of day into account—"
choice_data_list: (I need to take every precaution against the heat.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "So I was all fired up and prepared all sorts of countermeasure goods, but—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
This parasol is made from cooling fabric...
Just holding it open makes you feel cool and refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please, feel free to use it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
We also have refreshing iced lemon tea,
cold towels to wipe away your sweat...
A wide variety of items prepared for you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It seems it will be another hot summer...
so please, take good care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...This parasol...
It's the exact same one I gave you...!
choice_data_list: The other things I prepared might be pretty much the same...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing she doesn't handle strong sunlight well,
I brought every sun-protection item I could think of,
but...
choice_data_list: Looks like we were thinking the exact same thing.
We were thinking the same thing, weren't we?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It seems so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we can make it through summer with this.
All that's left is... for that girl to――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes... I'm okay.
I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Ever since the Oaks, my instincts... have been restless..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ――It whispers, "Pit them against each other soon."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her instinct seeks out the strong... and devours them.
Is it growing stronger as the race level rises?
Regardless—
choice_data_list: Let's be even more careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: She managed to achieve the Double Tiara. Running all the way through to the end—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: No matter what it takes, the Triple Tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please be strict with me. I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd already be here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Packed your bags already?
I'm impressed you're the first one ready, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you push too hard right from day one, the second half is gonna be rough. Make sure you pace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm thinking about it.
Are you done now?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You've had way too little composure lately.
At this rate, you won't even be able to fight the battles you could have won—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It has nothing to do with you, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Please, don't involve yourself with me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Leave me alone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A summer training camp where it felt like something was about to happen was beginning――
